families.agreement: Comparison of two or more declared or observed statements without judging which statement is true.
families.verification: Cryptographic signature or on-chain identity check result under a named rule.
families.reproduction: Cross-runtime comparison of itemwise and aggregate evaluation outcomes under a pinned instrument.
families.reading: Evidence-ladder or counter reading state from a named source.
families.absence_and_inability: Explicit terminal state where a source was absent, permissioned, partial, or unreachable; never mapped to zero or failure.

measurement.contract_parity.subject: MCP endpoint and contract dimension (AUTH, PAYMENT, PROTOCOL, TOOLS, VERSION)

states.meaning: Two or more speaking surfaces (registry, mcp.json, server card, payment manifest, live initialize/tools/list) agreed on the dimension.
Two or more speaking surfaces gave different values on the dimension; states that they disagree, not which surface is authoritative.
At least two surfaces were declared or observed for the dimension, but the comparison could not be completed.

measurement.a2a_card_signature.subject: Signed A2A agent card URL or registry listing

states.meaning: Every signature on the served card verified under the canonicalisation rule of its declared protocol version.
A cryptographic signature check on the served card did not pass under the canonicalisation rule of its declared protocol version.
The referenced key document or card bytes could not be retrieved or parsed.

measurement.cross_ledger_supply.subject: Tokenised asset deployment on a named ledger

states.meaning: A Merkle account and storage proof was verified against a block header state commitment.
A state proof was returned and its digest recorded, but it did not verify locally; the supply figure is the operator's answer.
The supply figure comes from an operator RPC/API response without a verified state proof.
Compared operator reads or deployment supply figures agreed.
Compared operator reads or deployment supply figures disagreed.
Every deployment on the issuer's list for the asset was read.
Only a subset of deployments on the issuer's list for the asset could be read.
The deployment is listed on the issuer's page but was not read by this probe; never treated as zero supply.
The asset lives on a permissioned ledger that an unauthenticated third party cannot read.
No public deployment list from the issuer could be retrieved.
An on-chain identity check did not pass; no supply is recorded against the asset.
The ledger read did not complete; never recorded as zero or absent.

measurement.cross_runtime_reproduction.subject: Signed evaluation card re-run on a second hardware/software runtime

states.meaning: Every item grade on the second runtime equalled the baseline runtime's grade (grade_equal == n_items).
Aggregate accuracy equalled the baseline runtime, while one or more per-item grades differed and cancelled out.
Aggregate accuracy on the second runtime differed from the baseline runtime.

measurement.public_signal.subject: Public counter or external index signal read on a given date

states.meaning: The public counter was read completely from its declared source URL.
Only part of the counter's underlying pages or items could be read.
The source could not be read; the observed value is null, never zero.

measurement.self_parity.subject: External directory listing or own-surface declaration of a CSOAI offering

states.meaning: The external directory listing or own-surface declaration matched the live served bytes.
One or more fields in the listing or declaration differed from the live served bytes.
The offering was absent from a complete read of an open directory.
The compared field was not declared on the surface.
The directory read was incomplete or unreachable.

measurement.tool_drift.subject: MCP endpoint observed at two times (T1 and T2) joined by exact URL

states.meaning: Tool names, descriptions, and canonical input schemas were identical at T1 and T2 (per_tool_hashes recorded at both times).
Sorted tool-name multiset hash was identical at T1 and T2; per-tool description and schema hashes were not recorded on both sides.
One or more tool names were present in the T2 multiset that were not present at T1 (combinable with '+' when multiple dimensions changed).
One or more tool names were present in the T1 multiset that were not present at T2 (combinable with '+').
The tool_names_sha256 digest changed between T1 and T2 where full name lists were not retained (combinable with '+').
One or more tools present at both times changed description content or presence (combinable with '+').
Raw description bytes differed while whitespace-collapsed description bytes were equal (combinable with '+').
One or more tools present at both times changed canonical inputSchema digest (combinable with '+').
The endpoint did not respond or tools/list was incomplete at T1 or T2.
